packageRules.description: hugomods tags put the variant first and the version last (exts-non-root-0.154.5); docker versioning cannot read them.
Images: digests, patches and minors automerge; majors get an MR. Hugo is 0.x, so a 0.155 minor can change template behaviour; the site build on deploy is the check.
The theme submodule is this owner's own repository; follow it.
